column2: W-what was that enormous sound!?
At this very moment, this entire $$世界$$...
is losing its sixth $$封印の鎖$$!!
Who is that voice?
I am the only one in this $$世界$$
who can convey the words of the being called God:
the $$教皇$$ of the $$アンゲルス教$$, known as the $$黒き聖母$$!!
Do you truly wish
to bring such ruin upon this $$世界$$!?
Unless the seven $$封印$$ upon Heaven's throne are broken...
the $$世界$$ will remain in its evil state, but...
when $$神の子羊$$ breaks each $$封印$$ in turn...
disaster, death, and conflict will spread throughout the $$世界$$...
and the earth will be beset by unprecedented chaos and calamity...
It is a passage from the famous prophetic text, $$人類の終末$$—the $$ハルマゲドン$$.
Look closely upon the earth through that window!!
Ever since you began breaking the armor's $$封印$$...
drought, cold spells, massive earthquakes, eruptions, tsunamis—every sort of disaster has spread across the earth...
And revolutionary groups have exploited this crisis to start riots...
Now the struggle between white and black $$羽$$ has grown into a full-scale war...
That is how far matters have escalated!!
Oh! The $$教皇$$ is speaking the words of our great god, $$サタン$$!!
How nostalgic...
Oh!! Hearing that divine voice,
we have recovered our $$記憶$$ of when we were $$大天使$$!!
That's right!!
Even if we cannot behold His holy countenance,
we always have
the protection of $$大神サタン$$!!
G-gh... Gyaaaaaah!!
Guh...
Just because you won by chance...
don't think you can rest easy. As long as we have this $$大天使の鎧$$...
we will rise again... as many times as it takes!!
The same is true of us...
just as $$ルピルピ$$ still lives within me...
Never did I expect all five of their souls to return at once...
There is no helping it now...
At least take that one's life...
and stop this $$世界$$ from collapsing!!
(Wh-what!?)
(What are these feelings...!?)
($$リリス$$'s $$記憶$$... are steadily growing stronger...!)
(Just as I thought, his armor...)
No! No... I won't accept it!!
Tch...
